leak-detector-bot: alert: public token-like string found in a sourcemap that appears to belong to staging app. URL: https://cdn.example.com/maps/staging.app.js.map

maria (eng-security): can someone confirm what token type this is? staging ingestion or something more privileged?

sam (sre): looking. quick grep on token pattern against token metadata... `platformctl tokens list --format json | jq '.[] | select(.value|test("redwood_ingest_v1"))'`

lee (devex): fwiw we shipped sourcemaps for staging artifacts to the CDN last week during the debug sprint. should have been stripped but maybe config leak.

sam (sre): matched one token: id tok_9f3b1-staging, scope=ingest:write, env=staging, created=2025-11-17, last_used=2026-02-12

olivia (product-security): scope looks limited to ingestion on staging but assume compromised. rotate and revoke first. Also check audit logs for any unusual calls.

maria (eng-security): agree. Steps: 1) revoke token 2) rotate any linked keys if used in build pipelines 3) search logs for calls with that token 4) check for exfil of customer data. I'll own 1+3.

lee (devex): command to revoke: `platformctl tokens revoke tok_9f3b1-staging --force --reason "sourcemap exposure 1825012345"`

sam (sre): on it. running revoke now. `platformctl tokens revoke tok_9f3b1-staging` -> success. token status=revoked

sam (sre): running quick audit: `logs query \"tok_9f3b1-staging\" --from 2026-02-01 --to now` - no hits outside our CI IP range yet. I'll run a wider scan across edge logs.

olivia (product-security): Check KMS bindings — was the token ever backed by a KMS-wrapped secret or ephemeral credential? If so, rotate CMK or rekey if compromise risk.

maria (eng-security): token was plain in source; not KMS-wrapped. But build pipeline service account has access to create tokens. We should rotate service account keys and audit runbooks.

lee (devex): opening a quick PR to change sourcemap publish step to strip secrets and gate publish to internal bucket. also adding a pre-publish scan in CI that fails on token regex.

maria (eng-security): Ticket created: SEC-7834. Action items: revoke (done), audit logs (sam), rotate pipeline creds (lee), update CI block (lee), customer impact check (maria).

sam (sre): pulled full edge logs -> 5 requests in last 48h from two external IPs; payloads are 200s but used endpoints were ingest/staging. No customer data returned (staging data only). Will add IP block and feed to WAF.

olivia (product-security): good. post-incident followups: enforce RBAC to ensure tokens can't be used cross-env, enable token-use audit webhook, KMS-wrap tokens for non-ephemeral ones, and update docs for sourcemap hygiene.

maria (eng-security): will schedule a 30-min postmortem call tomorrow 10:00 PST, invite SRE, DevEx, Product Sec. short notes in the ticket. :eyes:

lee (devex): quick note: added `leak-detector` CI job to fail builds with exposed tokens. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/devops/pulls/862

sam (sre): blocked IPs added to WAF, will monitor for retries. :shield:

maria (eng-security): thanks everyone. closing thread once postmortem is done. :thumbsup:
